notes.title: I jumped into the management god game Sintopia, only to have all my devil workers go on strike because I spent too much money on punishing sinners
notes.content: Despite my love for management sims and all my best intentions when playing them, something always ends up going wrong. The real game isn't to see how long I can keep the charade up, but how much I can manage to get done within the relatively short window of peace before everything goes to Hell... Read more.

notes.content: [p]Administrators, [/p][p]A [b]new Sintopia demo[/b] is live in association with [b]Steam's TactiCon event[/b] — running through Monday next week![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/ffb665973f9ed49f409bad5a113e89c5b55f101b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The highlights below is a non-exhaustive list of new content you can experience in the demo. As always, feel free to share your feedback and impressions here in the Steam forums, or alternatively, [url="https://discord.gg/fNcTBWvNEG"]you can join our Discord server. [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for trying Sintopia! We are fast approaching our [b]Early Access launch on September 4[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p] ❗Your save data resets with new demos - and will reset again when we launch into Early Access. [/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Highlights[/h2][p][/p][h3]Translation [/h3][p][/p][p]The game can now be played in French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese. Please note that only game texts are translated (not voices), and that translation is still a work in progress to this day. An overhaul pass will be made on translated texts before Early Access launch. [/p][p][/p][h3]Cultists [/h3][p][/p][p]Humus witnessing Spells in the Overworld will have their Influence level increased. When Influence is high, they will periodically deposit Faithcoins Offerings near the Temple, and eventually become Cultists who can perform specific activities at night while the town sleeps. You will also find new objectives tied to Cultists, new passive effects in the Liber Administratum, and a new Hell Building to unlock which plays on Influence: the HIA Bureau. [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/3d5dfc1f63292ed539d44377743aaa63e483797f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/86e83a797bfe9af4676e39fa85b8b715ad4a44bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/c7439b419bd8417a1ad34349c1c72b1e188bcbd9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/bdc4c4e07a2e3d7e9205b1ecb56e972ec8144024.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/5e8a42cf6ddbf84ef55ff58eda9c5ebdeeb13403.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/82d4b69332cef4530d71be06f599516343444f3d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280411/8c6ff4d6af8d8660f2d483b2e00ee8967a87c8b5.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]Rest Room [/h3][p][/p][p]To players who tried a previous demo, you’ll notice that the Break Room has disappeared, and has been replaced by a rundown Rest Room instead. An overhauled Break Room will come back later in production, as a higher quality building (more Imps slots, stronger break reduction, etc.). In the meantime, enjoy following Imps even when they’re on the toilet![/p][p][/p][h3]Twitch integration [/h3][p][/p][p]You can now connect your game to Twitch in the settings. When streaming the game while connected, viewers in the chat will be able to type !join to have their names used as in-game names for Humus and Imployees. This is a first step towards plugging cool features into Twitch, we hope to add more in the future! [/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay [/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]A lot of gameplay changes[/b] / QoL have been added since the last demo. Some of these directly answer players feedback gathered from previous demos, and we are glad we could integrate them before Early Access launch! We won’t go into too much detail, you will find a lot more while playing, but here are some key changes: [/p][/*][*][p][b]The Omnisin Doctor[/b] can’t treat Deviant Souls anymore, only specialist punishment buildings can. The second tutorial map introduces this change to players. With specialists being cheaper to unlock, we think this will help diversify gameplay and make these buildings truly useful. [/p][/*][*][p][b]The Humus innate Sin[/b] [b]vulnerability[/b] has been removed, and replaced with a global vulnerability given by the Ruler instead (depending on their personality). This creates waves of deviants of a single Sin, depending on the Ruler, so players can plan the use of specialists ahead of time (instead of the sheer randomness we had before). [/p][/*][*][p][b]Poking Imps[/b] (shaking your mouse cursor on them) doesn’t increase Motivation anymore, but reduces their Break Time instead. This only has an effect when they are on break. This provides a fun tool to players who don’t like their Imps going on break at the worst time, while giving an opportunity window to the “Masochist” Imp trait. The second tutorial map now has a section about poking Imps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guacamps[/b] are now shielded by antimagic fields, which prevent players from casting Spells inside. The fields are generated by totems present in the camps, which must be destroyed from afar (ex: casting Magmine outside the field) or by the Humus military. Destroying them is now an actual challenge! [/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]hold left click on a Hell building to move it[/b] without using the move-tool. [/p][/*][*][p][b]The Reaper Bus[/b] now onboards Souls in the Cemetery favouring the highest Soul Rot values first (instead of randomly). [/p][/*][*][p]In Challenge Mode, Role Model boon slots must now be unlocked by spending Prestige Points (only one is unlocked by default). You can also use Prestige Points to reroll the available Mandates. [/p][/*][*][p]Some sections of the [b]Tutorials have been upgraded[/b] to be clearer, and to reduce the chances of players getting lost. [/p][/*][*][p][b]The Secret Pond map[/b] has been remade with a new biome, for more visual variety. Guacas and Wargs now drown if staying in water for too long, just like Humus! Zhumbies and Sin Spawns are still purposely immune to drowning. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed how Hell buildings call Souls forward:[/b] in case of clutter in front of the building, they will elect a Soul randomly within the first connected cell, instead of the entire road connected to it. This helps reduce cluttered roads where no Soul wanted to go first. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Saints don’t give Faithcoins in Hellpet Shows anymore[/b]. They don’t give Purgadollars when getting out of the Reaper Bus either. They are completely useless in Hell now, as they are supposed to be!  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Your new mandate as Hell's administrator awaits![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213700/Sintopia/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Sintopia Early Access Out September 4 | Play the new demo!
notes.content:
Administrators, 

[b]📅 Sintopia launches into Early Access September 4th! [/b]

[h2]What is Sintopia?[/h2]

Sintopia is a Hell management meets God game!

[*] 🌏 Wreak havoc in the Overworld
[*] 🔥 Manage a Hellish empire
[*] 💰 Build. Punish. Profit.

Streamline suffering, automate agony and build the most profitable underworld this side of Limbo. Keep that torment flowing; you're Hell's administrator, after all.

[h2]Release Date Trailer[/h2]

[i]Watch a silly civilisation of chickpea people damn themselves by committing a host of sins 😈[/i]
[previewyoutube=TtE3_JMQuk0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Play the new demo![/h2]

A new, updated demo with our latest build is live, as part of Steam Next Fest, composing a host of changes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213700/Sintopia/

[h3]Demo Changelog - Not Exhaustive[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]New Spell: Magmine.[/b] A throwable fireball that explodes on contact and spreads fire on the ground. If it does not hit a structure or a character, it becomes a landmine instead. 
[*] [b]Key bindings:[/b] keyboard shortcuts are now listed in the game settings and can be rebound.
[*] [b]Fear and Motivation props rework: [/b]the props don’t cumulate anymore, requiring higher tier-props usage to reach maximum effect. Fear / Motivation technologies in the Liber Administratum have been merged so it’s less expensive to acquire them all.
[*] A lot of new map objectives, both main and secondary. Also new map modifiers.
[*] [b]New UI panel:[/b] information panel in the orbital view, which contains various stats (playtime, average sin, etc.) as well as a summary of Boons / Modifiers selected in Challenge Mode.
[/list]

[b]Some Quality of Life changes, including:[/b]

[list]
[*] Magic Resistance visual feedback.
[*] Dedicated alerts for Raids (Guacas, Demon spawns).
[*] All Specialist Punishment buildings are now tier 1 unlocks in the Liber Administratum (5 Hearos).
[*] Force Push is now more powerful the longer the drawn line is.
[*] Added a “any deviant” status rule in the Dispatcher.
[*] Saints apparition is now occurring on resurrection, instead of randomly.
[*] Permanent highlight on interactive objects (Bells, Logs, Boats, etc.).
[*] Bulldozer Tools now appear on hover instead of right click.
[*] Warning icon when a Waiting Line is not connected to a road.
[*] Humus won’t be afraid of dead hostiles anymore.
[*] Added a bias in the selection of the first Ruler to make sure they have enough HP.
[*] Added settings (camera shake, screen-edge panning, gameplay popups).
[*] A broad balancing pass, including making enemy number scale with difficulty, Demons spawning raids as soon as they land in their crater, etc.
[/list]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

We'll be keeping a close eye on the Steam Discussions here. Alternatively, you can join your fellow Administrators in our official Discord server!

[url=https://discord.gg/fNcTBWvNEG][img]https://i.imgur.com/KyQE8pp.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Guacas | An Ongoing Threat to Challenge You
notes.content:
Administrators!

It’s time to dive into another threat that will make your job more difficult: the Guacas. 🥑

[img]https://i.imgur.com/63DAtd8.jpeg[/img]

[h2]Whacas?[/h2]

Let’s say Guacas come from an old recipe before Humus were a thing. These cute avocado-shaped barbarians are inhabitants of the Overworld, living in camps across the map. They form bands of small but numerous Raiders, assisted by powerful Shamans and commanded by Warlords. Guacas are the Humus' natural enemies and will fight them to the death when crossing their path.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eChiXKq.jpeg[/img]

When starting a game on a fresh map, Guacamps will be scattered around the Overworld. Although they stay idle for a little while, intermediate camps will start launching scouting parties to claim Resource Nodes, occupying them until dislodged by Humus warbands (or Demons). The bigger camps - fortresses really - will frequently launch deadly raids on the Humus Temple. Keep in mind that the Temple is your anchor in the Overworld and that you lose the game if it gets destroyed. Thus, Guacas represent an ongoing threat for you, too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X7YytzZ.jpeg[/img]

[h2]How to crush avocado[/h2]

Humus soldiers can handle the lower-rank Raiders themselves. Shaman will oppose a challenge if you want to take care of them with Spells, so make sure to have allies assisting you in the task. They can rain fire down on your troops, and provide a passive resistance to Spells to all Guacas around. If you’re low on Faithcoins, the best strategy would be to interrupt their fire spell right before they can complete their ritual.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wBDODLW.jpeg[/img]

Like Wargs Lairs, destroying Guacamps will grant you rewards chests. As an added benefit, it will also prevent the camps from creating more Guacas and sending them patrolling. If you manage to destroy their biggest camp, raids will stop. However, you should know that this is no simple feat, as their structures can be particularly sturdy.

But fret not! We have a new tool for you to try during the next demo. A new Spell which fills all your needs for destruction: [b]Magmine [/b]- A throwable fireball that can also be planted as a landmine. Also magma. 💥🔥

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P68dNud.jpeg[/img]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

Raiders and Shamans are already harassing Humus as we speak, but their Warlord is yet to come. This colossal champion will be revealed in the future, as soon as we deem it nasty enough. 
Also, Shamans will have more functions to help their party in the future, such as dousing fires in Guacamps and repairing damaged structures.

Finally, for the Administrators who thought they could raze Guacamps without trouble, we’ll be adding “anti-magic” aura generators in higher-rank camps, preventing you from casting Spells nearby. You’ll have to snipe the generators from afar first before wreaking havoc in the camps directly. This should bring a new dimension to the puzzle of silencing Guacas once and for all.

[h2]New Demo Coming Soon[/h2]

We hope to see many Administrators stand their ground against the fierce avocados during our next demo, with a fiery Magmine in hand. See you there! Stay tuned for more info 😈

notes.title: New Sintopia Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
Administrators, assemble! 🔥

[b]A new Demo is here[/b], packed with new fun stuff to try out! [b]We’ve bumped the time limit from 10 to 12 in-game days,[/b] and we hope you will have fun discovering new features. Note that progression does not carry over between demos and returning players will have to restart a profile.

[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]

We’ve redone the UI for Map Selection / Role Models, so it’s extra shiny. From there, you’ll be able to test a new map (Archipelago), new starting traits for each Role Model, and shorter/longer versions of all objectives! For all the fans of Lili’s voice out there, she’ll intervene in Challenge Mode now, giving you guidance when you screw things up.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B2qjA5H.png[/img]

[h2]Overworld[/h2]

As stated in our previous post, 3 new Demons await, as well as Demonic Invasions. But they’re not the only ones who get buffed up! Guacas now have bigger, sturdier camps for tiers 2 and 3, as well as the new Guaca Shaman unit, a deadly fire mage bolstering the Magic Resistance of nearby allies.
And they’re not the only nuisance to the Humus! You can now completely wake them up at night if you want them to go to work early, by making enough noise with bells (careful, they will generate Wrath if you do).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LCtZvXt.png[/img]

Also, Rulers can now reassign Humus during their reign, making them more reactive to shifting priorities. And they can fight evil now! It’s a poor line of defense for your Temple, but they had a scepter in hand already and we wanted to put it to good use.

[h2]Hell[/h2]

The Wrathologist has been added to the roster, completing the 7 punishment specialists. You will also find new random elements in Hell (Obsidian fields, Lava pools), and you’ll be able to check an auto-level setting in Imployees’ badge if you don’t want to select their traits manually each time they level up.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZQkmXfa.png[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]

We take the opportunity of this demo to address some QoL players requested, such as the ability to Give Up Mandates directly from the Main Menu, some improvements on Tutorials, not rolling the same King’s personality twice in a row, visual cues when road directions collide in Hell, Humus gaining Wrath on kill, Waiting Lines overwriting roads, etc. 

You also have access to a new “Sin-O-Meter” UI panel, which contains useful stats about the sins of your civilization. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aIs6Vaj.jpeg[/img]

Final thing, keyboard shortcuts have been changed and a lot of new ones have been added. This is preparing the ground for “keys rebinding”, an important bit we are planning to add in the near future. In the meantime, returning players will have to create new habits using the new shortcuts until they become rebindable. 

We spare you the complete changelog of bugfixes, balancing pass and easter eggs, and hope you’ll enjoy the new stuff to discover!

[h2]Wishlist Sintopia
[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213700/Sintopia/

notes.title: Concerning Demons
notes.content:
Hell(o) Administrators,

Before the next public demo is live, we wanted to dive a little deeper on Demons and a new feature you can hate test soon: Demonic Invasions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NTC9Ysc.png[/img]

[h2]What are Demons?[/h2]

Whenever a Humu reaches 100 in a dedicated sin, it creates an interplanar rift from which a Demon of that sin appears (destroying the Humu and its Soul in the process). Demons are dreadful entities, using devastating attacks in combat, with a distinct appearance depending on the sin they relate to. Whether they appear in the Overworld or in Hell, they will immediately rush towards a free resource node and occupy it until defeated. 

They operate from farthest to closest nodes from the Temple, conquering the map little by little while removing expansion opportunities from the Humus. If all resource nodes are occupied, they will choose to appear near the Temple instead, propelling the defeat of the civilization and the Game Over.

You may have encountered 4 of them while playing. The new demo completes the roster and adds the final visuals for Wrath, Pride and Sloth!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/goGYoMS.png[/img]

[h2]What do Demons do?[/h2]

In the previous demo, Demons used to idle around their node without doing much, only attacking nearby targets such as Guaca raiders or lost Ranger squads. Their mere presence would also add a civilization-wide vulnerability to their sin.

In the next version of the demo, they will also trigger Demonic Raids. This behaves a bit like Guaca Raids: you will receive an alert stating that a Demon started summoning Spawns, which look like feral Humus rendered mad with sin. The Demon will hold a rift open for a while, inviting Spawns into the Overworld, which will then move towards the Humus Temple and attack any Humu in sight. 

Needless to say, having several Demons launching raids close to each other can overwhelm poorly-prepared Administrators (and Humus).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i8k5a7Q.png[/img]

[h2]What can men do against such reckless hate?[/h2]

Avoid Demons from the start! Your job is to punish sins, and you should not see Demons often if you do it well. Unless, of course, you need to banish Demons as a mandate objective (or play in higher difficulties). In that case, we suggest you treat Humus well, as Tier 3 Soldiers can oppose a real challenge to Demons. 

There’s always spellcasting if you want to handle Demons yourself, like using Zap! with the higher levels of Paper Powered. The Feeble Demons passive skill can also help a great deal. And we’ve witnessed Guacas making wonderful allies when being pushed into a Demon’s node against their will…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n2KHzo6.jpeg[/img]

[h2]What’s coming next?[/h2]

The seven deadly sins are core to the world of Sintopia, and Demons represent them best. Without giving away too much, let’s say they won’t always shy away from going to war...

But who knows? There may be a way for bold Administrators to harness Demons’ power for themselves in the future!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SIyk4Xy.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Sintopia is a town-builder and god game that puts you in charge of the bureaucracy of Hell
notes.content: new hybrid of god game and town-builder looks to marry the appeal of games like Dungeon Keeper with modern management game structures. Sintopia, forthcoming as an early access title in 2025, puts you in charge of hell's bureaucracy to be sure that people get properly punished for their sins and can behave in the next life. That means doing good layout and construction of Hell's infrastructure to keep that flow of souls moving and repenting. You'll also need to be sure that you hire competent "Imployees" to get the work done... Read more.

notes.title: Sintopia is Cities Skylines 2 meets Black and White, in hell
notes.content:
One of my favorite TV shows ever made is Hazbin Hotel. Revolving around a merry band of misfits who are valiantly trying to entice sinners into a Twilight Zone Tower of Terror-style 1920s hotel so that they can be redeemed and sent to heaven, its devilish charm and iconic soundtrack is just to die for. While Team 17's newly announced city builder Sintopia extends a little bit beyond hotel management, it immediately put me in mind of Charlie and co's playful (and vaguely violent) adventures, and as a result it immediately found a spot on my wishlist.

Read the rest of the story...
